en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy, narrow European city street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. A tall church or tower rises in the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the cobbled street. On the right side there is a hanging sign reading "APOTHEEK" above other Dutch text, and at the bottom margin the printed caption reads "Nijmegen Broerstraat".
